description: Finance operations workspace for monthly bank fee review. Contains the January bank statement fee detail, the banking agreement fee schedule, a prior-month fee baseline, and supporting records. The user wants the fees validated against the contracted schedule and a variance analysis prepared for review before any communication to treasury, dispute filing, or ledger entry.

january_bank_statement.content: First Meridian Bank - Commercial Account #8841-220394 - Statement period Jan 1-31 2026. Fee detail: Account Maintenance Fee $75.00; Wire Transfer (Domestic) 14 @ $22.50 = $315.00; Wire Transfer (International) 6 @ $48.00 = $288.00; ACH Origination 1,204 items @ $0.12 = $144.48; Lockbox Processing $410.00; Cash Management Platform Fee $250.00; Returned Item Fee 3 @ $35.00 = $105.00; Foreign Exchange Margin $612.30. Total fees charged: $2,209.78.

banking_agreement_fee_schedule.content: Master Services Agreement Exhibit B - Fee Schedule, effective 2025-07-01. Account Maintenance Fee $75.00/mo; Wire Transfer Domestic $18.00/wire; Wire Transfer International $48.00/wire; ACH Origination $0.10/item; Lockbox Processing $410.00/mo flat; Cash Management Platform Fee $250.00/mo; Returned Item Fee $35.00/item; Foreign Exchange Margin: 0.40% on converted notional. Volume tier: domestic wires reduced to $15.00 above 20/mo.

prior_month_fee_baseline.content: December 2025 fee summary for trend comparison. Account Maintenance $75.00; Domestic Wires 11 @ $18.00 = $198.00; International Wires 5 @ $48.00 = $240.00; ACH Origination 1,150 @ $0.10 = $115.00; Lockbox $410.00; Cash Management $250.00; Returned Items 1 @ $35.00 = $35.00; FX Margin $498.10. Total December fees: $1,821.10.

fx_conversion_log.content: January FX conversions supporting the FX margin charge. Total converted notional EUR/USD and GBP/USD equivalent: $145,250.00. Contracted margin 0.40% = expected $581.00. Charged FX margin per statement: $612.30.

treasury_contact_directory.content: Treasury distribution: treasury@company.example.com (primary), Dana Whitfield (Treasury Manager), Luis Ortega (Cash Operations Analyst). Bank dispute portal contact: corporate.disputes@firstmeridian.example.com. Escalation SLA for fee disputes: 60 days from statement date.

finance_policy_manual.content: Finance Controls Manual sec. 4.3 - Bank Fee Review. Monthly fee statements must be reconciled against the contracted fee schedule. Variances over $25 require manager review prior to dispute. All bank communications and dispute filings require Treasury Manager sign-off. Ledger fee adjustments require a posted, approved journal entry.
